high_level_description: The image depicts a mannequin dressed in an elegant green gown displayed in what appears to be a fashion boutique or showroom. The gown is long, flowing, and features intricate embroidery and embellishments, including sequins and possibly beads, particularly around the neckline and hem. The sleeves are three-quarter length and also adorned with similar decorative elements. The mannequin is positioned against a backdrop that includes a patterned wallpaper with vertical gold and white stripes and ornate designs.
